_note: P66/P75 attest. The solemn double amen saying: 'You will see heaven opened and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.' KEY VARIANTS: (1) Byzantine adds ἀπ᾽ ἄρτι after the second ἀμήν — P66/P75/Vat/Sin/Vulg/Pesh omit; (2) Sinaiticus reads ὄψεσθαι (infinitive) where P66/P75/Vat/Byz read ὄψεσθε (2nd plural future); (3) Sinaiticus reads ἠνεωγότα where others read ἀνεῳγότα. ΥΥ = υἱοῦ, ΑΝΘ = ἀνθρώπου (nomen sacrum in papyrus/Vaticanus/Sinaiticus). Angels ascending/descending alludes to Gen 28:12 (Jacob's ladder).
